## Known-good baseline

Record the asset number, model, visible damage, startup result, display, sound, operating system, and unusual behaviour before service. This evidence distinguishes a pre-existing problem from one introduced during the activity.

![A labelled desktop-computer cutaway.](/assets/tej/Computer_System_Cutaway.svg){width=90%}

## Physical lab L21

Shut down, unplug, use the approved ESD area, photograph cable locations, and open only the directed chassis panel. Identify the PSU, motherboard, CPU cooler, RAM, storage, fans, and power/data cables.

::: {.callout-important title="Stop and ask"}
Stop for liquid, a swollen cell, burnt areas, damaged insulation, loose metal, an unknown modification, or uncertainty. Never open the PSU.
:::

Submit the baseline, labelled photograph, safety sign-off, and after-reassembly check.
